claims.violated_requirement: The module must correctly detect the sequence '011100' and properly transition to checking the next group when a mismatch occurs
claims.spec_basis: The sequence check begins with every sixth bit of input data, meaning the module processes the input in groups of six bits and does not overlap or reuse bits between groups. If the first bit of a group does not match the sequence, the module skips the entire group and starts checking from the next group beginning at the seventh bit.
